batches.purpose: Grow the installed AUZiX userland with small terminal tools that fit the /Programs command-suite pattern before heavier native packages.

packages.notes: Pager for logs, receipts, docs, and long command output.
GNU tar compatibility package; BusyBox tar remains base fallback.
GNU gzip/gunzip/zcat compatibility package for logs and package workflows.
Do not ship as a plain command-suite binary only; Git also needs git-core helpers, templates, exec-path, and CA/SSH integration.

batches.purpose: Expose installed Flatpak apps as AUZiX commands and menu entries.
